title.rendered: Mavericks Event Center Wedding DJ Half Moon Bay

content.rendered:
Mavericks Event Center Wedding

Ceremony & Reception DJ Half Moon Bay

Date: Saturday, November 02, 2013
Times: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM

Guests: 150
107 Broadway, Half Moon Bay, CA

 

Their ceremony was heartfelt, With a Bagpiper playing and the waves rolling in, and we played the ceremony music and provided wireless mic for the officiant. It was the start of the surfing tournament at the Mavericks.
Their reception was fun, with R&B Hits, Motown, 90′s Country, Rock,Hip Hop,  and also some Oldies Songs for Stephanie’s family.
The food was excellent catered by the Half Moon Bay Brewing Company.
